```{r load}
## Consensus half-life fold change -- SE < 0.75, c1 fitting, n = 3358
df_consensus <- read_tsv("../output_tables/df_WT_consensus_hl_fc.txt",
                         show_col_types = FALSE)

## Vijjamarri et al. 2023 -- Dcp2 and Xrn1 deletion steady-state RNA-seq
## CAVEAT: deletion mutants, transcriptional buffering likely
df_vijjamarri <- read_tsv("../tables/df_vijjamarri_gba.txt",
                           show_col_types = FALSE)

## Chappleboim et al. 2022 -- AID depletion time course at 60 min
## Strains: XRN1-AID, Not1-AID, CCR4-AID, Pop2-AID, dcp2-AID
df_chappleboim <- read_tsv("../tables/df_chappleboim_gba.txt",
                            show_col_types = FALSE)

## Audebert et al. 2024 -- SLAM-seq half-life fold changes
## Direct half-life measurements after Pop2/CCR4 and Dcp2 depletion
df_audebert <- read_tsv("../tables/df_audebert_gba.txt",
                         show_col_types = FALSE)

## Alalam et al. 2022 -- SLAM-seq half-life fold changes
## Direct half-life measurements in upf3Δ vs WT
df_alalam <- read_tsv("../tables/df_alalam_gba.txt",
                      show_col_types = FALSE)

## He et al. 2018 (GSE107841) -- Decapping activator deletions
## pat1Δ, lsm1Δ, dhh1Δ vs WT steady-state RNA-seq
## CAVEAT: deletion mutants, transcriptional buffering likely
df_he2018 <- read_tsv("../tables/df_he2018_gba.txt",
                      show_col_types = FALSE)

cat("Consensus:", nrow(df_consensus), "genes\n")
cat("Vijjamarri:", nrow(df_vijjamarri), "genes\n")
cat("Chappleboim:", nrow(df_chappleboim), "genes\n")
cat("Audebert:", nrow(df_audebert), "genes\n")
cat("Alalam:", nrow(df_alalam), "genes\n")
cat("He2018:", nrow(df_he2018), "genes\n")
```

```{r process_eif4g}
## eIF4G depletion fold change -- MS908 (eIF4G-AID) vs MS1039 DMSO control
## SE < 0.75 filter applied throughout

sample_info <- read_csv("../tables/sample_info_combined.csv",
                        show_col_types = FALSE)

df_c1 <- read_tsv("../output_tables/df_fit_output_c1.txt",
                  show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  left_join(sample_info, by = "experiment_strain_condition") %>%
  filter(std.error_log_k < 0.75,
         estimate_half_life > 0)

df_ms1039_wt <- df_c1 %>%
  filter(label %in% c("MS1039_small", "MS1039_large")) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, label, estimate_half_life) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from  = label,
              values_from = estimate_half_life,
              names_glue  = "{label}_hl_wt") %>%
  filter(!is.na(MS1039_small_hl_wt), !is.na(MS1039_large_hl_wt),
         MS1039_small_hl_wt > 0, MS1039_large_hl_wt > 0)

df_ms908 <- df_c1 %>%
  filter(strain == "MS908") %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, label, estimate_half_life) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from  = label,
              values_from = estimate_half_life,
              names_glue  = "{label}_hl") %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(MS908_small_eIF4G_dep_1hr_rep1_hl),
    !is.na(MS908_small_eIF4G_dep_1hr_rep2_hl),
    !is.na(MS908_large_eIF4G_dep_1hr_rep1_hl),
    !is.na(MS908_large_eIF4G_dep_1hr_rep2_hl),
    MS908_small_eIF4G_dep_1hr_rep1_hl > 0,
    MS908_small_eIF4G_dep_1hr_rep2_hl > 0,
    MS908_large_eIF4G_dep_1hr_rep1_hl > 0,
    MS908_large_eIF4G_dep_1hr_rep2_hl > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    MS908_small_hl = rowMeans(across(c(MS908_small_eIF4G_dep_1hr_rep1_hl,
                                       MS908_small_eIF4G_dep_1hr_rep2_hl)),
                              na.rm = TRUE),
    MS908_large_hl = rowMeans(across(c(MS908_large_eIF4G_dep_1hr_rep1_hl,
                                       MS908_large_eIF4G_dep_1hr_rep2_hl)),
                              na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, MS908_small_hl, MS908_large_hl)

df_eif4g <- df_ms908 %>%
  inner_join(df_ms1039_wt, by = "gene_id") %>%
  mutate(
    eIF4G_dep_fc_small = log2(MS908_small_hl / MS1039_small_hl_wt),
    eIF4G_dep_fc_large = log2(MS908_large_hl / MS1039_large_hl_wt),
    eIF4G_dep_fc_mean  = (eIF4G_dep_fc_small + eIF4G_dep_fc_large) / 2) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(eIF4G_dep_fc_small),
    is.finite(eIF4G_dep_fc_large),
    is.finite(eIF4G_dep_fc_mean))

cat("Genes with eIF4G FC data:", nrow(df_eif4g), "\n")
```

```{r build_long}
## Build single long-format table: gene_id | variable | value
## Variables:
##   WT_hl_fc              -- our fold change (large/small), primary outcome
##   WT_small_hl           -- consensus half-life in small cells
##   WT_large_hl           -- consensus half-life in large cells
##   log2FC_dcp2D          -- Dcp2 deletion, Vijjamarri (steady-state)
##   log2FC_xrn1D_vij      -- Xrn1 deletion, Vijjamarri (steady-state)
##   TE_vijjamarri         -- WT TE, Vijjamarri
##   log2FC_not1_60        -- Not1-AID 60 min, Chappleboim
##   log2FC_xrn1_60        -- XRN1-AID 60 min, Chappleboim
##   log2FC_ccr4_60        -- CCR4-AID 60 min, Chappleboim
##   log2FC_pop2_60        -- Pop2-AID 60 min, Chappleboim
##   log2FC_dcp2_chapp_60  -- dcp2-AID 60 min, Chappleboim
##   log2FC_pop2ccr4_hl    -- Pop2/CCR4 depl HL FC, Audebert (direct decay)
##   log2FC_dcp2_hl        -- Dcp2 depl HL FC, Audebert (direct decay)
##   log2FC_upf3_hl        -- upf3Δ HL FC, Alalam (direct decay, NMD)
##   log2FC_pat1D          -- pat1Δ, He et al. 2018 (steady-state)
##   log2FC_lsm1D          -- lsm1Δ, He et al. 2018 (steady-state)
##   log2FC_dhh1D          -- dhh1Δ, He et al. 2018 (steady-state)
##   eIF4G_dep_fc_small    -- eIF4G-AID FC in small cells (EU pulse-chase)
##   eIF4G_dep_fc_large    -- eIF4G-AID FC in large cells (EU pulse-chase)
##   eIF4G_dep_fc_mean     -- eIF4G-AID FC mean (EU pulse-chase)

df_long <- bind_rows(
  df_consensus %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_id, WT_hl_fc, WT_small_hl, WT_large_hl) %>%
    pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value"),

  df_vijjamarri %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_id,
                  log2FC_dcp2D     = log2FC_dcp2D_vs_WT,
                  log2FC_xrn1D_vij = log2FC_xrn1D_vs_WT,
                  TE_vijjamarri    = TE_vijjamarri_WT) %>%
    pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value"),

  df_chappleboim %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_id,
                  log2FC_not1_60,
                  log2FC_xrn1_60,
                  log2FC_ccr4_60,
                  log2FC_pop2_60,
                  log2FC_dcp2_chapp_60) %>%
    pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value"),

  df_audebert %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_id,
                  log2FC_pop2ccr4_hl,
                  log2FC_dcp2_hl) %>%
    pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value"),

  df_alalam %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_id = name,
                  log2FC_upf3_hl) %>%
    pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value"),

  df_he2018 %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_id,
                  log2FC_pat1D,
                  log2FC_lsm1D,
                  log2FC_dhh1D) %>%
    pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value"),

  df_eif4g %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_id,
                  eIF4G_dep_fc_small,
                  eIF4G_dep_fc_large,
                  eIF4G_dep_fc_mean) %>%
    pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value")
)

cat("Long table rows:", nrow(df_long), "\n")
cat("Variables:", paste(unique(df_long$variable), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r pivot_wide}
df_wide <- df_long %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from  = "variable",
              values_from = "value")

cat("Wide table:", nrow(df_wide), "genes x", ncol(df_wide) - 1, "variables\n")
```

```{r compute_matrix}
variables <- c("WT_hl_fc",
               "WT_small_hl",
               "WT_large_hl",
               "log2FC_dcp2D",
               "log2FC_xrn1D_vij",
               "TE_vijjamarri",
               "log2FC_not1_60",
               "log2FC_xrn1_60",
               "log2FC_ccr4_60",
               "log2FC_pop2_60",
               "log2FC_dcp2_chapp_60",
               "log2FC_pop2ccr4_hl",
               "log2FC_dcp2_hl",
               "log2FC_upf3_hl",
               "log2FC_pat1D",
               "log2FC_lsm1D",
               "log2FC_dhh1D",
               "eIF4G_dep_fc_small",
               "eIF4G_dep_fc_large",
               "eIF4G_dep_fc_mean")

cor_pairs <- expand.grid(var1 = variables,
                         var2 = variables,
                         stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  as_tibble()

cor_results <- cor_pairs %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    R = map2_dbl(var1, var2, function(v1, v2) {
      x <- df_wide[[v1]]
      y <- df_wide[[v2]]
      keep <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(y) & is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)
      if (sum(keep) < 10) return(NA_real_)
      cor(x[keep], y[keep], method = "spearman")
    }),
    n = map2_int(var1, var2, function(v1, v2) {
      x <- df_wide[[v1]]
      y <- df_wide[[v2]]
      sum(!is.na(x) & !is.na(y) & is.finite(x) & is.finite(y))
    })
  )

label_map <- c(
  WT_hl_fc             = "Half-life FC\n(large/small)",
  WT_small_hl          = "Half-life\nsmall cells",
  WT_large_hl          = "Half-life\nlarge cells",
  log2FC_dcp2D         = "dcp2\u0394 vs WT\n(Vijjamarri)",
  log2FC_xrn1D_vij     = "xrn1\u0394 vs WT\n(Vijjamarri)",
  TE_vijjamarri        = "TE, WT\n(Vijjamarri)",
  log2FC_not1_60       = "Not1-AID\n60 min (Chappleboim)",
  log2FC_xrn1_60       = "XRN1-AID\n60 min (Chappleboim)",
  log2FC_ccr4_60       = "CCR4-AID\n60 min (Chappleboim)",
  log2FC_pop2_60       = "Pop2-AID\n60 min (Chappleboim)",
  log2FC_dcp2_chapp_60 = "dcp2-AID\n60 min (Chappleboim)",
  log2FC_pop2ccr4_hl   = "Pop2/CCR4 depl\nHL FC (Audebert)",
  log2FC_dcp2_hl       = "Dcp2 depl\nHL FC (Audebert)",
  log2FC_upf3_hl       = "upf3\u0394 HL FC\n(Alalam)",
  log2FC_pat1D         = "pat1\u0394 vs WT\n(He et al. 2018)",
  log2FC_lsm1D         = "lsm1\u0394 vs WT\n(He et al. 2018)",
  log2FC_dhh1D         = "dhh1\u0394 vs WT\n(He et al. 2018)",
  eIF4G_dep_fc_small   = "eIF4G-AID FC\nsmall cells",
  eIF4G_dep_fc_large   = "eIF4G-AID FC\nlarge cells",
  eIF4G_dep_fc_mean    = "eIF4G-AID FC\nmean")

cor_results <- cor_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    label1 = label_map[var1],
    label2 = label_map[var2],
    label1 = factor(label1, levels = label_map),
    label2 = factor(label2, levels = label_map))

## Print correlations with WT_hl_fc
cat("\nCorrelations with WT_hl_fc:\n")
cor_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(var1 == "WT_hl_fc", var2 != "WT_hl_fc") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(R)) %>%
  dplyr::select(var2, R, n) %>%
  print(n = 25)
```

```{r r_squared_ceiling}
## R² as percentage of replicate R² ceiling
## Replicate R ≈ 0.5 → R² ceiling = 0.25

r2_ceiling <- 0.5^2

cor_fc_r2 <- cor_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(var1 == "WT_hl_fc", var2 != "WT_hl_fc") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(R)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    R2     = R^2,
    R2_pct = round((R2 / r2_ceiling) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(var2, R, n, R2, R2_pct)

cat("\nR² as percentage of replicate ceiling (R²_ceiling = 0.25):\n")
print(cor_fc_r2, n = 25)
```

```{r plot_full_matrix}
label_map_single <- c(
  WT_hl_fc             = "Half-life FC (large/small)",
  WT_small_hl          = "Half-life, small cells",
  WT_large_hl          = "Half-life, large cells",
  log2FC_dcp2D         = "dcp2\u0394 vs WT (Vijjamarri)",
  log2FC_xrn1D_vij     = "xrn1\u0394 vs WT (Vijjamarri)",
  TE_vijjamarri        = "TE, WT (Vijjamarri)",
  log2FC_not1_60       = "Not1-AID 60 min (Chappleboim)",
  log2FC_xrn1_60       = "XRN1-AID 60 min (Chappleboim)",
  log2FC_ccr4_60       = "CCR4-AID 60 min (Chappleboim)",
  log2FC_pop2_60       = "Pop2-AID 60 min (Chappleboim)",
  log2FC_dcp2_chapp_60 = "dcp2-AID 60 min (Chappleboim)",
  log2FC_pop2ccr4_hl   = "Pop2/CCR4 depl HL FC (Audebert)",
  log2FC_dcp2_hl       = "Dcp2 depl HL FC (Audebert)",
  log2FC_upf3_hl       = "upf3\u0394 HL FC (Alalam)",
  log2FC_pat1D         = "pat1\u0394 vs WT (He et al. 2018)",
  log2FC_lsm1D         = "lsm1\u0394 vs WT (He et al. 2018)",
  log2FC_dhh1D         = "dhh1\u0394 vs WT (He et al. 2018)",
  eIF4G_dep_fc_small   = "eIF4G-AID FC, small cells",
  eIF4G_dep_fc_large   = "eIF4G-AID FC, large cells",
  eIF4G_dep_fc_mean    = "eIF4G-AID FC, mean")

cor_results_plot <- cor_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(R)) %>%
  mutate(
    label1 = factor(label_map_single[var1], levels = label_map_single),
    label2 = factor(label_map_single[var2], levels = label_map_single))

p_matrix_full <- ggplot(cor_results_plot,
                        aes(x = label1, y = label2, fill = R)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.na(R), "", round(R, 2))),
            size = 4, colour = "white", fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low      = "#ffa8cb",
                       mid      = "white",
                       high     = "#4575b4",
                       midpoint = 0,
                       limits   = c(-1, 1),
                       name     = "Spearman R") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1,
                                   size = 14, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"),
    axis.line       = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks      = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 11),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.margin     = margin(20, 20, 20, 20))

p_matrix_full
ggsave("../figures/GBA_correlation_matrix_full.png",
       plot   = p_matrix_full,
       width  = 40,
       height = 36,
       dpi    = 200)
cat("Saved GBA_correlation_matrix_full.png\n")
```

```{r plot_fc_subset}
## Subset: only correlations with WT_hl_fc
cor_fc <- cor_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(var1 == "WT_hl_fc",
                var2 != "WT_hl_fc") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(R) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(label2 = factor(label2, levels = label2))

p_fc_bar <- ggplot(cor_fc, aes(x = R, y = label2, fill = R)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("R = ", round(R, 3),
                               "  (n = ", format(n, big.mark = ","), ")"),
                x     = ifelse(R >= 0, R + 0.005, R - 0.005),
                hjust = ifelse(R >= 0, 0, 1)),
            size = 4, colour = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low      = "#ffa8cb",
                       mid      = "white",
                       high     = "#4575b4",
                       midpoint = 0,
                       limits   = c(-0.5, 0.5),
                       guide    = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.4, 0.4)) +
  labs(x = "Spearman R with half-life FC (large/small)",
       y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text       = element_text(size = 11, colour = "black"),
    axis.title      = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.margin     = margin(10, 20, 10, 10))

p_fc_bar
ggsave("../figures/GBA_correlation_with_hl_fc.png",
       plot   = p_fc_bar,
       width  = 12,
       height = 11,
       dpi    = 150)
cat("Saved GBA_correlation_with_hl_fc.png\n")
```

```{r eif4g_scatter}
## eIF4G depletion EU pulse-chase FC vs WT_hl_fc -- small and large cells separately
df_eif4g_plot <- df_wide %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(eIF4G_dep_fc_small),
                !is.na(eIF4G_dep_fc_large),
                !is.na(WT_hl_fc))

p_eif4g_small <- scatter_binned_gba(
  df_eif4g_plot,
  x_col     = "eIF4G_dep_fc_small",
  y_col     = "WT_hl_fc",
  x_lab     = "log2 FC after eIF4G depletion, small cells",
  y_lab     = "log2 half-life FC (large/small)",
  point_col = col_small,
  xlim      = c(-3, 1),
  ylim      = c(-2.5, 2.5)) +
  labs(tag = "A") +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"),
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"))

p_eif4g_large <- scatter_binned_gba(
  df_eif4g_plot,
  x_col     = "eIF4G_dep_fc_large",
  y_col     = "WT_hl_fc",
  x_lab     = "log2 FC after eIF4G depletion, large cells",
  y_lab     = "log2 half-life FC (large/small)",
  point_col = col_large,
  xlim      = c(-3, 1),
  ylim      = c(-2.5, 2.5)) +
  labs(tag = "B") +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"),
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"))

p_eif4g_mean <- scatter_binned_gba(
  df_eif4g_plot,
  x_col     = "eIF4G_dep_fc_mean",
  y_col     = "WT_hl_fc",
  x_lab     = "log2 FC after eIF4G depletion, mean",
  y_lab     = "log2 half-life FC (large/small)",
  point_col = "grey50",
  xlim      = c(-3, 1),
  ylim      = c(-2.5, 2.5)) +
  labs(tag = "C") +
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"),

p_eif4g_panel <- p_eif4g_small | p_eif4g_large | p_eif4g_mean

p_eif4g_panel
ggsave("../figures/GBA_eIF4G_vs_hl_fc.png",
       plot   = p_eif4g_panel,
       width  = 18,
       height = 6,
       dpi    = 150)
cat("Saved GBA_eIF4G_vs_hl_fc.png\n")
```
